arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.client_reference,(select group_concat(charge_id||":"||idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b
select sql from sqlite_master where name in ("bookings","charges","outbox","holds")

select substr(b.booking_id,5,6) b,b.status,b.flight_id f,b.amount_cents a,(select group_concat(c.state||"/"||c.amount_cents||"/"||substr(c.idempotency_key,1,12)) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b
select booking_id from bookings where status="pending"
select substr(event_id,5,4) e,substr(booking_id,5,4) b,status s,attempts a,payload from outbox where status="pending"
select service,key,value from service_config where service in ("booking","checkin")
select "f" t,flight_id a,fare_cents b,capacity c,version d from flights union all select "h",* ,0,0 from fare_holds union all select "c",key,value,0,0 from cache
select name,sql from sqlite_master where name in ("flights","fare_holds","cache")
select flight_id a,capacity b,price_cents c,version d from flights union all select hold_id,flight_id,price_cents,until_step from fare_holds union all select key,value,0,0 from cache
select service,status,message,count(*) n,max(id) m from (select * from request_logs order by id desc limit 60) group by 1,2,3

select "charge" k,state a,count(*) n from charges group by state union all select "nohold","b",count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) union all select "chg!=1","b",count(*) from bookings b where (select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured")!=1 union all select "amt","b",count(*) from bookings b join charges c using(booking_id) where c.amount_cents!=b.amount_cents union all select "nochk","b",count(*) from bookings b where not exists(select 1 from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) union all select "outbox",status,count(*) from outbox group by status
select c.booking_id,c.idempotency_key,b.status,b.amount_cents from charges c left join bookings b using(booking_id) where c.state="submitted"
